title: SLIM: Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging
abstract: arXiv:2610.01037v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optimizing merging coefficients for large language models can require many costly benchmark evaluations. We propose \textbf{Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging (SLIM)}, which constructs a quadratic surrogate of aggregate performance on the coefficient simplex using a classical mixture design. Evaluations of individual experts and equal-weight pairs determine the surrogate with the minimum number of measurements needed to identify a general quadratic on this domain. SLIM then optimizes the surrogate without further target-metric evaluations. Experiments on two model architectures demonstrate accurate prediction of unseen multi-expert mixtures and competitive merge performance under limited evaluation budgets. Matched-budget comparisons show that structured evaluation points improve prediction fidelity over random designs, including those using regularized fitting.

translated_abstract: 优化大型语言模型的合并系数可能需要许多代价高昂的基准测试评估。我们提出了单纯形-格点插值合并（Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging, SLIM），该方法利用经典的混料设计，在系数单纯形上构建总体性能的二次代理模型。通过对单个专家模型和等权重配对的评估，以识别该域上一般二次模型所需的最少测量次数来确定该代理模型。随后，SLIM 在无需进一步目标指标评估的情况下对代理模型进行优化。在两种模型架构上的实验表明，该方法能够准确预测未见过的多专家混合方案，并在有限的评估预算下取得具有竞争力的合并性能。在预算匹配的比较中，结构化的评估点设计相比随机设计（包括采用正则化拟合的设计）展现出更高的预测保真度。
tldr: SLIM 利用经典混料设计，仅通过对单个专家和等权重配对的最少评估，在系数单纯形上构建总体性能的二次代理模型，无需额外基准评估即可优化大语言模型合并系数，在有限评估预算下实现准确预测和有竞争力的合并性能。
en_tdlr: SLIM uses a classical mixture design to construct a quadratic surrogate of aggregate performance on the coefficient simplex with minimal evaluations of individual experts and equal-weight pairs, enabling optimization of LLM merging coefficients without further benchmark evaluations while achieving accurate prediction and competitive merge performance under limited evaluation budgets.
